selection.outer_contexts: five immutable maps times five folds
selection.feature_ranking: split-local sum of squared standardized feature/coefficient correlations
selection.refit: reselect features and refit on the full outer-training partition
selection.aggregation: average five map-specific coefficient predictions per well

models.ridge: median imputation, fold-only standardization, LSQR, frozen alpha grids
models.pls: summary features, fold-only preprocessing, frozen component grid
models.knn: summary features, fold-only target-aware ranking, Euclidean inverse-distance weighting
models.privileged: six train-only formation-offset changes plus finite masks; diagnostic only

metrics.tvt: exact E006 plus spline7 sufficient-statistic SSE
metrics.coefficient_r2: global Frobenius R2 around the seven target-dimension means
metrics.coefficient_pearson: seven marginal Pearson correlations; frozen median
metrics.oracle_gain_retention: (E011 RMSE - candidate RMSE)/(E011 RMSE - spline7 oracle RMSE)
metrics.neighbor_enrichment: best frozen legal-space/k reduction versus deterministic suffix-length-quintile matched random pairs
metrics.stress: legacy spatial, legacy typewell, legal covariate clusters, 2D spatial clusters, horizon quintiles

controls.shuffled_target: deterministic outer-training derangement; inner selection uses pseudo targets only
controls.sign_flipped: negative of the selected best legal averaged coefficient prediction
controls.negative_control_gate: maximum gain of either control must not exceed 0.03 RMSE

decision.go: all seven frozen legal gates pass
decision.strong_privileged_mediation: privileged RMSE <=5.5 while legal GO fails
decision.stop: all legal RMSE values exceed 10 or all legal multivariate R2 values are below 0.25
decision.research_only: partial signal outside GO and STOP
